mapper.select:
SELECT IFNULL(p.product_name, s.product_name) AS product_name, s.*, e.equip_name, v.vendor_name, p.material, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quality_hardness_meas m WHERE m.spec_id = s.spec_id) AS meas_count, (SELECT MAX(m.meas_dt) FROM quality_hardness_meas m WHERE m.spec_id = s.spec_id) AS last_meas_dt FROM base_hardness_spec s LEFT JOIN base_equipment e ON e.equip_code = s.equip_code LEFT JOIN base_product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id LEFT JOIN base_vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id
AND s.use_yn = #{useYn} AND s.equip_code = #{equipCode}
AND (s.part_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY s.equip_code, s.part_no, s.item_name

SELECT IFNULL(p.product_name, s.product_name) AS product_name, s.*, e.equip_name, v.vendor_name, p.material FROM base_hardness_spec s LEFT JOIN base_equipment e ON e.equip_code = s.equip_code LEFT JOIN base_product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id LEFT JOIN base_vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id WHERE s.spec_id = #{specId}
SELECT * FROM base_hardness_spec WHERE equip_code = #{equipCode} AND part_no = #{partNo} AND item_name = #{itemName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO base_hardness_spec (equip_code, product_id, part_no, product_name, item_name, unit, lsl, usl, target, decimals, sample_size, use_yn, remark, reg_user_id, reg_user_name) VALUES (#{equipCode}, #{productId}, #{partNo}, #{productName}, #{itemName}, #{unit}, #{lsl}, #{usl}, #{target}, #{decimals}, #{sampleSize}, #{useYn}, #{remark}, #{regUserId}, #{regUserName})
mapper.sql: m.*, s.decimals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quality_hardness_set x WHERE x.meas_id = m.meas_id) AS set_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quality_hardness_value v JOIN quality_hardness_set x ON x.set_id = v.set_id WHERE x.meas_id = m.meas_id) AS value_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quality_hardness_value v JOIN quality_hardness_set x ON x.set_id = v.set_id WHERE x.meas_id = m.meas_id AND ((m.lsl IS NOT NULL AND v.value < m.lsl) OR (m.usl IS NOT NULL AND v.value > m.usl))) AS ng_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quality_hardness_meas m JOIN base_hardness_spec s ON s.spec_id = m.spec_id WHERE m.meas_id = #{measId}
SELECT * FROM quality_hardness_meas WHERE receiving = 'Y' AND status = '측정중' ORDER BY upd_dt DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(meas_no, LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM quality_hardness_meas WHERE meas_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quality_hardness_meas (meas_no, spec_id, part_no, product_name, item_name, unit, lsl, usl, sample_size, lot_no, equip_code, meas_dt, status, worker_name, remark, reg_user_id, reg_user_name) VALUES (#{measNo}, #{specId}, #{partNo}, #{productName}, #{itemName}, #{unit}, #{lsl}, #{usl}, #{sampleSize}, #{lotNo}, #{equipCode}, #{measDt}, '측정중', #{workerName}, #{remark}, #{regUserId}, #{regUserName})
mapper.update: UPDATE quality_hardness_meas SET status = #{status}, judgement = #{judgement}, completed_dt = #{completedDt}, receiving = CASE WHEN #{status} = '완료' THEN 'N' ELSE receiving END WHERE meas_id = #{measId}
UPDATE quality_hardness_meas SET receiving = 'N' WHERE receiving = 'Y'
UPDATE quality_hardness_meas SET receiving = #{receiving} WHERE meas_id = #{measId}
UPDATE quality_hardness_meas SET upd_dt = NOW() WHERE meas_id = #{measId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quality_hardness_set WHERE meas_id = #{measId} ORDER BY seq, set_id
SELECT v.* FROM quality_hardness_value v JOIN quality_hardness_set s ON s.set_id = v.set_id WHERE s.meas_id = #{measId} ORDER BY s.seq, v.idx
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(seq), 0) FROM quality_hardness_set WHERE meas_id = #{measId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quality_hardness_set (meas_id, set_type, seq) VALUES (#{measId}, #{setType}, #{seq})

INSERT INTO quality_hardness_value (set_id, idx, value, source, device_id, measured_at) VALUES (#{setId}, #{idx}, #{value}, #{source}, #{deviceId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = VALUES(value), source = VALUES(source), device_id = VALUES(device_id), measured_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM quality_hardness_value WHERE set_id = #{setId} AND idx = #{idx}
mapper.select: SELECT m.meas_id AS measId, m.meas_no AS measNo, m.lot_no AS lotNo, m.equip_code AS equipCode, m.meas_dt AS measDt, s.set_id AS setId, s.set_type AS setType, s.seq AS seq, v.idx AS idx, v.value AS value FROM quality_hardness_meas m JOIN quality_hardness_set s ON s.meas_id = m.meas_id JOIN quality_hardness_value v ON v.set_id = s.set_id WHERE m.spec_id = #{specId} AND m.status = '완료' AND m.meas_dt >= #{from} AND m.meas_dt < #{to} ORDER BY m.meas_dt, m.meas_id, s.seq, s.set_id, v.idx
